# Overview

On 9/23 we did our final assessment of the Sequim environmental hardening oysters for Effort A and closed out this project! We checked on the PolyIC outplants and left those deployed.  

## Final assessment 

We did the following today to assess and close out the Effort A experiment: 

- Collected all Effort A seed bags (7 bags) from the lines and brought them up to the beach
- Removed oysters from each bag and counted mortalities
- Arranged oysters for a photograph to capture number of live animals and for growth analysis
- Tag and scale bar included in each photo
- Subsampled oysters from each bag to total n=~30 oysters per treatment group (2 treatment groups total) into red mesh bags with their own tag labels for survival assays in the lab (see below)
- Bags and equipment were cleaned 
- Two temperature loggers were downloaded that were brought in on the bags. There is still one logger remaining with the PolyIC outplants in the field and I added one more to an outplant bag. 
- I recorded data and uploaded size image photos.  

All data is in our [10K seed GitHub repo](https://github.com/RobertsLab/project-gigas-conditioning/).
